number_of_fractions.evidence: The resulting 24 bRP fractions were analyzed by LC−MS/MS using a Nano-Acquity HPLC system (Waters) interfaced with a QExactive HF (Thermo-Fisher Scientific).

number_of_samples.evidence: Ten samples (NCI-N87 cells were transfected with either scRNA21, nscRNA, or PBS blank control at 1 h, 8 h, and 24 h after transfection, or transfected with synthetic circRNA directed against miR-93 at 8 h after transfection), each containing 50 ug protein, were reduced in 5 mmol/L dithiothreitol (DTT) for 1h at 57°C, then alkylated with in mmol/L iodoacetamide.
